title: A woman is suing Apple because she didn't think the iPhone had a notch - check out Apple's marketing and decide for yourself (AAPL)
text: A woman is suing Apple because she didn’t think the iPhone had a notch — check out Apple’s marketing and decide for yourself (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Dec 14, 2018, 4:56 pm 7 pts Apple's iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max have a "notch" on the top of the device to make room for the front-facing camera. However, many Apple marketing images use a black background where the notch is less visible. One person said in a legal complaint filed Friday that she did not know the device had…
